It is a name that carries a deep traditional meaning and resonates with the purity and innocence of childhood. In Hindu society, it is common to give children names that are influenced by Hindu mythology, religions texts or philosophical concepts. Sahaj, with its literal meaning of 'natural' or 'unaffected', fits perfectly into this cultural context.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Sahaj is deeply rooted in Hindu philosophy, specifically in the concept of "Sahaja Samadhi", or the natural state of enlightenment. This is a state where a person is in communion with their inner self and the universe. The name Sahaj symbolizes this state of being, reminding us of the importance of staying true to our inner nature and living in harmony with the world around us. It is a reminder to embrace the simplicity and purity of our own being and to let go of the external distractions that may cloud our inner wisdom and peace.
